title: Con-Quest
summary: A $5 interactive charity adventure from the Gearbox Union, built around challenges, bottle caps and raffle tickets.

content.text: Donate $5 to receive a GBU Con-Quest pouch, five raffle tickets and a one-day questing pass. Use the event map to visit participating tables and complete playful challenges.

items: Complete table quests such as character impressions, dances, quotes and other challenges.
Earn GBU Con-Quest bottle caps for completed quests.
Trade bottle caps at the Mega-Table for more raffle tickets.
Quests, trade values and hidden surprises can change each day.
Start at the Gearbox Union Con-Quest Mega-Table, Tables D1–D7 upstairs outside the ballroom.

content.text: Vendors, Artists & Guests
Exhibitors can volunteer as quest stops by contributing to the charity raffle and offering a simple interactive challenge at their table. Contact GearboxUnion@gmail.com to participate.

title: Costume Contest
summary: Annual costume competition with junior, teen and adult divisions plus special adult awards.

items: Registration & optional prejudging: Saturday, Oct. 17 • 2:30–5:00 PM • Panel Room 2
Costume Contest: Saturday, Oct. 17 • 6:00 PM • Panel Room 1

content.text: Costumes may draw from fantasy, science fiction, anime, steampunk, horror, movies, television, books and other fandoms.

items: Trophies: 1st, 2nd and 3rd place in each age division.
Adult entries are also eligible for Best of Show and Judge's Choice.

content.text: Entry Information
Entrants should be ready to provide a costume title, the source or genre that inspired it, and information for the judges about construction, materials and the story behind the costume.

title: Medieval Combat Demos
summary: Dagorhir battle-game demonstrations outside on the lawn, followed by opportunities for attendees to try foam combat.

items: Saturday • 1:00–2:00 PM and 4:00–5:00 PM • Outside on the Lawn

content.text: Members of the Wolves of Asgard and Iron Mountain units demonstrate full-contact foam-weapon combat, rules, techniques, safety and equipment, with support from the Gearbox Union.
After the demonstration, attendees can try foam weapons. Waivers are required and minors must be supervised by a parent or guardian.

title: Tabletop Gaming
summary: All-weekend tabletop play hosted by Snake Eyes Gaming and Sentinels' Keep Gaming Society.

content.text: Friday through Sunday • All day • Game Room
Warhammer 40k: Bug Hunt

A weekend-long drop-in, drop-out scenario. Players control a unit, complete objectives and earn points. Play as many times as you like; a special prize goes to the top-scoring player at the end of the weekend. New players are welcome.
Magic: The Gathering – Casual Commander
Four-player Commander pods launch on demand, with promos for winners. Decks can be purchased if needed.
HeroClix – Battle Royale
Draft a booster and join a four-player group battle with 50-minute rounds. Promos are added to the prize pool.

title: Trivia Tournament
summary: Geek-culture trivia spanning sci-fi, fantasy, comics, movies, TV and games, with trophies and Best Buy gift cards.

content.text: Play solo or with friends and compete across a wide range of fandom categories.

title: Workshops
summary: Miniature painting, model building, 3D printing and foam-smithing activities throughout the weekend.

content.text: Paint & Take / Build & Battle by Snake Eyes Gaming

Paint & Take provides a miniature, paints and tools with guidance available. Build & Battle offers models such as Gundam, Pokémon and Warhammer kits with supplies and assistance. Anyone under 18 must be accompanied by an adult for Build & Battle. Pricing depends on the chosen miniature or model.
Miniature Painting Competition

items: Youth division: age 15 and under. Adult division: age 16 and up.
Models and supplies are provided; personal models and hobby supplies are not permitted.
Winners announced Sunday at 2:00 PM in the Paint and Hobby Room.
1st, 2nd and 3rd place prizes in each category, based on attendance.

content.text: 3D Printing & Foam Smithing by Snowtiger Designs
Visit Snowtiger Designs at Table D9 for demonstrations and hands-on workshops covering 3D printing and foam-smithing techniques used in cosplay and prop making.
